script
Class Scatter

java.lang.Object
  |
  +--script.Scatter
public class Scatter
extends java.lang.Object

This class represents the information on how to scatter a script.

Field Summary
 java.lang.String bsubString
          a String to be appended to the master bsub script when the scatter is completed
 int commandsConsumed
          number of commands consumed by this scatter (place holder so that the higher level knows where to continue when scatter ends)
 int currThreads
          current number of threads being generated
 java.lang.String dependency
          String which contains the job array name to use as a dependency by the next job in the bsub script
 java.lang.String linearString
          a String to be appended to the master linear script when the scatter is completed
 int maxThreads
          maximum number of threads that can be generated without a warning.
 int mulFact
          Overall factor by which this scatter increases the number of scripts
 script.ResolvedScatterParam[] params
          the array of resolved scatter parameters which can be used to retrieve the correct value for each script being generated
